dn29:36.25: imāyapi kho ahaṃ cunda paññattiyā neva attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo
dn29:36.26: athakho ahameva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhipaññatti.
dn29:36.27: ime kho te cunda pubbantasahagatā diṭṭhinissayā ye te mayā byākatā yathā te byākātabbā
dn29:36.28: yathā ca te na byākātabbā kiṃ te ahante tattha byākarissāmi.
dn29:37.1: katame te cunda aparantasahagatā diṭṭhinissayā ye te mayā byākatā yathā te byākatā
dn29:37.2: yathā ca te na byākātabbā kiṃ te ahaṃ te tattha byākarissāmi.
dn29:37.3: santi cunda eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
dn29:37.4: rūpī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti.
dn29:37.5: santi kho pana cunda eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
dn29:37.7: rūpī ca arūpī ca attā hoti.
dn29:37.10: asaññī attā hoti. saññī ca asaññī ca attā hoti.
dn29:37.12: attā ucchijjati vinassati na hoti paraṃ maraṇā idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti.
dn29:38.1: tatra cunda ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
dn29:38.2: rūpī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti
dn29:38.5: rūpī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇāti

dn29:40.1: imesañca cunda pubbantasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ imesañca aparantasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya evaṃ mayā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā desitā paññattā.
dn29:40.3: idha cunda bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn29:40.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn29:40.7: imesañca cunda pubbantasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ imesañca aparantasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya evaṃ mayā ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā desitā paññattāti.
dn29:41.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upadāno bhagavato piṭṭhito ṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ vījayamāno.
dn29:41.5: supāsādiko vatāyaṃ bhante dhammapariyāyo ko nāmāyaṃ bhante dhammapariyāyoti.
dn29:41.6: tasmātiha tvaṃ upadāna imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ pāsādikotveva dhārehīti.
dn29:41.8: attamano āyasmā upadāno bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
